name: Chance
overview: Scripture reveals that what may appear as chance or randomness is ultimately under God's sovereign control, as seen in Proverbs 16:33 where the casting of lots is directed by the LORD. While Ecclesiastes 9:11 acknowledges that time and chance affect all people, Psalms 115:3 and Isaiah 46:9 affirm that God governs all events according to His will. This truth encourages believers to trust God’s providence in situations involving risk or uncertainty, including the concept of second chances and the wisdom needed when taking chances.
